info.title: runx - repo command runner for .NET projects
info.description: A repo command runner for .NET projects.

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help.

options.name: --version
options.description: Show version.

options.name: --list
options.description: List tasks without prompting.

options.name: --init
options.description:
Create a starter runx.json.
--init --personal       Create your personal tasks file for this repo, outside the repo.

options.name: --scope
options.description: With --init --personal: global, a remote such as origin, or repo.

options.name: --force
options.description: Overwrite an existing file with --init.

options.name: --where
options.description: Show which task files apply here.

options.name: --new
options.description: Create a script task in the task folder (eng/tasks by default).

options.name: --type
options.description: ps1 (the default), cs, sh, or cmd.

options.name: --description
options.description: The task's description.

options.name: --depends
options.description: A task to run first. Repeat or comma-separate.

options.name: --hide
options.description: Keep the task out of the picker and --list.

options.name: --info
options.description: Describe a task: what it runs, where it comes from, its plan.

options.name: --check
options.description: Validate all tasks without running anything.

options.name: --json
options.description: With --list, --info, or --check, write JSON.

options.name: --guide
options.description: Explain how to add tasks, for people and AI agents.

options.name: --install-skill
options.description: Install the runx skill for Claude Code.

options.name: --file
options.description: Use an explicit runx.json path.

options.name: --allow-parent-search
options.description: Allow config discovery beyond the safe search boundary.

options.name: --dry-run
options.description:
Print the resolved task without executing it.
Run 'runx --guide' to learn how to add tasks.
